message.content: In the discussions, several solutions have been proposed to make the garden more comfortable on sunny days. One idea is to add shade structures, such as umbrellas or a pergola, around the seating areas. Additionally, plants can be strategically placed around the seating area to create a more natural and secluded ambiance. Another suggestion is to incorporate a water feature, such as a small pond or fountain, which not only adds beauty but also provides a soothing sound and attracts wildlife. This multi-faceted approach aims to ensure that the garden remains a pleasant and inviting space throughout the year, regardless of the weather.
